name: De Appel
known: Contemporary art centre at Tolstraat 160, Amsterdam: an exhibition space, a curatorial and educational lab, and an art library and archive (stated by the space).
Saskia Bos set up the Curatorial Programme in 1994.

Past directors include Ann Demeester, Lorenzo Benedetti and Monika Szewczyk, and Lara Khaldi became director in 2023, with Eszter Szakács as interim director from October 2025 to March 2026 (Wikipedia, 2025 annual report).

Ammodo funds the Curatorial Programme; project funders include Amsterdam's Zuid and Oost districts, the Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie, Fonds21, Het Cultuurfonds, Stichting DOEN, the Vriendenloterijfonds and the ELJA Foundation (stated by the space).
The supervisory board is chaired by Bart Beekman, a judge at the Amsterdam district court;
It names no parent, founder or university.

name: Foam Fotografiemuseum Amsterdam
known: Governance: director Karin van Gilst; supervisory board chair Jeroen van Ingen (Sony Music Entertainment), with Shivan Shazad, Lotte van Zuijlen and Auke van den Hout.

name: Framer Framed
known: Directors Cas Bool and Josien Pieterse have led the executive board since 2019.
The supervisory board is Una Henry (chair), Paula Albuquerque (vice-chair), Hans Schamlé, Vinca Kruk, Barbara Wegelin and Amira Gad.

name: Het Concertgebouw
known: Dick Boer, a former Ahold executive, has chaired the NV since 2017;
Jeroen van der Veer, a former Shell executive, left the foundation's chair in October 2025 (NOS).

name: Mediamatic
known: Founders Willem Velthoven and Jans Possel stepped back from their active roles in 2024 after four decades.
Marcel Sturing is the new general director, and Velthoven stays involved in 2025 as his coach (annual report 2024, translated).
2024 supervisory board: Hajo Doorn (chair, paid €1,750) and Farid Tabarki (member, paid €1,400) (annual report 2024).

name: OT301 (Vereniging EHBK)
known: The Amsterdammer (Elitsa Kaleva, 22 January 2023) quotes co-founder Ivo Schmetz calling OT301 non-commercial, with a goal of keeping spaces and events affordable.

name: Rijksmuseum
known: The museum's website lists the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science as its founder.
The Ministry of Education, Culture and Science is its founder.

name: Sonic Acts
known: Wikipedia says it was founded by Paradiso and the ArtScience Interfaculty, which included the Royal Academy of Art and the Royal Conservatory of The Hague, and that the festival was originally held each year at Paradiso.

name: Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam
known: Rein Wolfs has been artistic director since 2019 (Wikipedia).

name: W139
known: Board in 2024 (2024 report): Bart Rutten (chair), Remco Mol (treasurer), George Korsmit (secretary until the end of his term in January 2025), Iris Kensmil (until 13 October 2024) and Susan Kooi (secretary from 13 October 2024);
Annette Wolfsberger is director (2024 report).
